events.name: Washington Capitals at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Tom Wilson had two goals and an assist, and the Washington Capitals beat the New York Islanders 4-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson scores twice as the Capitals beat the Islanders 4-1 for their 4th straight win

headlines.description: — Connor Bedard scored the tie-breaking goal at 9:55 of the third period, added an empty-net score and had two assists as the Chicago Blackhawks rallied from an early three-goal deficit to top the Anaheim Ducks 5-3 on Sunday and snap a five-game slide.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bedard's 4 points lead Blackhawks to a 5-3 comeback win over Ducks

headlines.description: — Carolina rookie Brandon Bussi made 15 saves for his first NHL shutout, Nikolaj Ehlers scored at 2:52 of overtime and Hurricanes beat the Calgary Flames 1-0 on Sunday for their second straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bussi makes 15 saves for 1st NHL shutout, Ehlers scores in OT in Hurricanes' 1-0 win over Flames

headlines.description: — Wyatt Johnston’s fourth career hat track included two power-play goals, giving him an NHL-best 12, and Jason Robertson had the winning goal and two assists in his 400th career NHL game as the Dallas Stars beat the Ottawa Senators 6-1 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Johnston's hat trick leads Stars past Senators 6-1 for 4th consecutive win
